channel.title: Gustavo — tavin.dev
channel.description: Deep technical articles on DDD, CQRS, hexagonal architecture, and TypeScript backend patterns.

item.title: When AI Agents Meet Real Engineering
item.description: AI coding agents aren't exposing model limits — they're exposing architecture debt. Why good boundaries matter more than better prompts.

item.title: CQRS Beyond the Basics: When Queries Should Skip Your Domain Model
item.description: Command handlers orchestrate domain logic through ports. Query handlers bypass it entirely. The asymmetry is intentional — here's why and how.

item.title: Hexagonal Architecture in NestJS: Ports, Adapters, and the Testing Payoff
item.description: How to structure a NestJS module as a bounded context with ports, adapters, and the concrete testing advantages this unlocks.

item.title: Two Ways to Model Aggregates in TypeScript
item.description: Mutable state machines vs immutable copy-on-write — two real patterns for DDD aggregates in TypeScript, their trade-offs, and when to use each.
